watches.name: Freiheit Automatic Black
watches.description: EXTREMELY LIMITED SALE - FINAL STOCK The new and improved Freiheit is now available to purchase. Accompanied now by Domed, Anti-Reflective Sapphire glass to provide even further security to your watch. Our new automatic watch sits comfortably on your wrist with a current diameter of 40mm and a thickness of 13mm. The sleek Bauhaus design creates a new level of class with any outfit you decide to wear. The Freiheit is powered by the Miyota 8215 Automatic movement due to its traditional, reliable and popular reputation. Powered by 21 jewels, it has a 42-hour power reserve. The movement offers an accuracy of -20 / +40 sec per day. watches.name: Chrono Black
watches.description: “ Every person has a legacy. You may not know what your impact is, and it may not be something that you can write on your tombstone, but every person has an impact on this world.” Introducing The Chrono to the legacy. This 40mm Seiko Quartz Chronograph watch is built with the same durability and precision as our other Quartz models. The movement used gives the second hand the impression of an automatic watch, gently and consistently ticking around the dial. Accompanied by two sunken sub dials for closer visualization of your timekeeping. The sleek and unique design of our Chronograph watch will be sure to leave an impression on your peers. Dial Black Hands Silver Diameter 40 mm Material 316L Stainless Steel Case height 7.9 mm Lug width 20 mm Water Resistance Up to 5 ATM Glass Domed Sapphire, Anti-Reflective Movement Quartz Chronograph Movement - Seiko YM91 Strap (Leather) Soft Calf 20 mm Leather Length (Leather) 75 mm / 115 mm Strap (Mesh) Stainless Steel 20 mm Milanese Mesh Length (Mesh) 75 mm / 110 mm

watches.name: Edel Black
watches.description: “We must begin thinking like a river if we are to leave a legacy of beauty and life for future generations.” Introducing The Edel to the legacy. This 38mm Quartz watch is built with the same durability and precision as our Löwenherz and Furchtlos models. Crafted with a new dial to further expand your legacy collection. The Edel is accompanied by a 6-window date to optimise the classic design's symmetry. A lug width of 20mm ensures that you can use your existing straps to easily customise your style. Our Edel collection offers your style impeccable quality, class, and importance.
